- Unknown trackers: a new background guard keeps watching with the app closed and alerts you when a tracker follows you
- Unknown trackers: your own tags no longer raise alerts. States are now read as in AirGuard: a SmartTag connected to its owner, or only just disconnected, is safe, and an offline SmartTag is recognised across its 15-minute identity changes
- Unknown trackers: Chipolo and Pebblebee tags are now detected
- New Mobile network tool: Fake cell detector. It watches the network, even with the app closed, for the signs of an IMSI catcher: forced 2G, test network codes, inconsistent area codes, cells without neighbours, unusually strong new cells, or no matching ANFR mast nearby
- The BitChat tool is removed
- Home screen: the selection outline no longer breaks into corners when switching from one card to another
